messages:
Ava (People Ops): Quick heads-up: were running a short "Mandatory Data Security Attestation + QA" window next week (Mon-Fri). Everyone must complete the attestation form and the 8-min privacy refresher by Friday 09/12 EOD.

Ava (People Ops): If you own controls, please also upload any updated evidence to /Evidence/Security-Attest-2026. Use filename format: team_controlid_shortdesc_YYYYMMDD.pdf (example: ops_AC-5_key-rotation_20260908.pdf).

Jordan (Security): Small technical note: for exports include a tiny README with collection window and retention. Example for GCS exports: 
```bash
gsutil cp gs://redwood-evidence/logs/req-logs-20260907.json ./ && echo "Retention: 90d" > README_req-logs-20260907.txt
```
Place README next to the JSON.

Elias (Ops): Will upload the session token rotation logs Wednesday. Question: for very large exports (>100MB), should we still upload to the drive or link to S3?

Jordan (Security): For >50MB, upload to the evidence S3 path and include a 1-page manifest PDF in the Drive that contains the S3 path + checksum. See the manifest naming pattern in the tracker.

Kai (Legal): If your artifact references an external contract or third-party data, do NOT upload full contract text. Instead upload a short excerpt + pointer to the contract in the legal vault and add a note in the tracker.

Ava (People Ops): Office hours: Tue 11:00-12:00 & Thu 15:00-16:00 in #help for filename checks and quick QA. Bring one sample filename and well confirm.

Elias (Ops): Noted. Ill bring the filename and the manifest example.

ComplianceBot: Reminder: engineering has 4 outstanding attestations, infra has 2. Deadline 09/12 23:59 UTC.

Jordan (Security): If you need a short extension for legal review/redaction, open an "attest-ext" ticket and tag @Kai. Well triage same-day but ask that teams try to stay within the window.

Ava (People Ops): Quick FAQ: Q: Do contractors need to complete the attestation? A: Yes. Contractors must complete the attestation and either upload evidence or a manager-signed attestation confirming they do not handle secrets/PII. Use the contractor folder.

Kai (Legal): If you redact PII, include a redaction rationale doc and signed confirmation. Legal turnaround ~48-72h.

Ava (People Ops): TL;DR: do the refresher + attestation by 09/12 EOD, upload control evidence if you own controls, use manifests for big files, join office hours for QA. Ping me or @Jordan/@Kai with blockers. :white_check_mark:
